_help: Amazon Associates picks for the home page 'Wig-day essentials on Amazon' section. Every link is built as https://www.amazon.com/s?k=<query>&tag=<tag>, so the tag below is added automatically. To change a tile, edit its name, blurb or query (the Amazon search words). To add one, copy a tile and pick an icon: stand, bonnet, cap, glue, tint, wash, heat, brush. To link one exact product instead of a search, add "url" with your SiteStripe link (it must already contain tag=get786-20). Do not add prices or copied Amazon product photos: Amazon only allows those from its own tools (SiteStripe / Product Advertising API). Rebuild with: node scripts/build.mjs. Rules: https://affiliate-program.amazon.com/help/operating/agreement Photos: free Unsplash images (https://unsplash.com/license), set per tile in "image" (base images.unsplash.com URL, sizing is added by the build) with "alt" text. They are illustrative, not the exact Amazon product. Remove "image" to fall back to the icon.
disclosure: As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases.
